title: Signal: NuGet package entry without a version
scope: A packages.config file that declares a `packages.config` entry that records no version.
limitations: It matches a `packages.config` entry that records no version in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A packages.config that mentions a `packages.config` entry that records no version in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
